name: subagent-fence
description: Refuses force-pushes, pushes to protected branches, --no-verify and kills by process name; optionally fences off listed paths, a subagent's edits to a shared checkout and its whole-file reads of large files

guard_force_push.title: Refuse force-pushes
guard_force_push.description: Refuse git push --force, --force-with-lease, -f and +refspec pushes, for the main session and subagents alike.

guard_protected_branches.title: Refuse pushes to protected branches
guard_protected_branches.description: Refuse a git push whose target is one of the protected branches below.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Branch names a push may not target (for example main, master, dev).

guard_no_verify.title: Refuse git --no-verify
guard_no_verify.description: Refuse any git command that passes --no-verify, which skips the repository's hooks.

guard_kill_by_name.title: Refuse killing processes by name
guard_kill_by_name.description: Refuse pkill, killall, taskkill /IM and Stop-Process -Name, which can kill another session's processes. Kill by PID instead.

banned_paths.title: Banned paths
banned_paths.description: Folders that may never be read, written or entered, by the main session or a subagent. Empty by default.

guard_shared_checkout.title: Keep subagents out of shared checkouts
guard_shared_checkout.description: Refuse a subagent's edits and mutating git commands in a plain git checkout (one whose .git is a folder), so it works in its own worktree instead. Off by default, because it also stops a subagent working in your only checkout.

shared_checkout_root.title: Shared checkout root
shared_checkout_root.description: Only treat checkouts under this folder as shared. Leave empty to detect a shared checkout anywhere: any folder whose .git is a directory, not the .git file a linked worktree has.

read_limit_bytes.title: Whole-file read limit (bytes)
read_limit_bytes.description: Refuse a subagent's Read of a text file larger than this when the call gives no limit, so it reads by offset and limit instead. 0 turns the check off.
